row.title: Executor step hung to the job timeout and wrote no row
row.body: The executor step ran 12 minutes and was cancelled with no provenance row, so liveness read the executor clock stale for 160 h. EXEC-WATCHDOG-1 in foundation/executor.py ends the run at 10 minutes, records a stalled row and exits clean; test WatchdogTests.
